app.name: mdsf
app.one_liner: Format and lint code blocks in Markdown documents using external tools.

screens.name: CLI Interface
screens.purpose: Provide command-line access to formatting, linting, configuration, and tool management features.

rust_commands.name: cache_cleanup
rust_commands.purpose: Remove outdated formatting cache entries to free disk space.

rust_commands.name: format
rust_commands.purpose: Format code blocks in Markdown files using configured external tools.

rust_commands.name: init
rust_commands.purpose: Generate a new configuration file with specified schema version and format (TOML/YAML).

rust_commands.name: verify
rust_commands.purpose: Check whether code blocks in Markdown files are correctly formatted without modifying them.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add support for TOML configuration loading
week 1: Implement core CLI parsing and dispatch
week 1: Integrate basic formatting with built-in tool registry
acceptance_tests: Given a Markdown file with unformatted Python code block, when mdsf format is run, then the code block is reformatted using black.
Given a valid mdsf config in YAML, when mdsf verify is executed, then it reports no errors if all code blocks match expected formatting.
Given custom tool definition in config, when mdsf format runs on matching language alias, then the custom command is invoked correctly.
